user.title: Govee BLE Air Purifier
user.description: Choose a recently seen purifier whose BLE name contains H712 followed by one ASCII letter or digit (case-insensitive), or enter its BLE address manually. Only H7124 has been tested. Other H712 models use the H7124 protocol fallback and may not work or may expose mismatched features.

data_description.address: Only required when Recently seen purifier is set to Enter address manually.

polling.title: Polling
polling.description: Configure how often Home Assistant reads this purifier. The default is selected for the detected model.

data_description.polling_interval: How often Home Assistant actively connects over BLE to read power, PM2.5, filter life, and profile-enabled night-light state.

custom_auto.title: Five Air Quality Steps
custom_auto.description: Configure increase confirmation and the four boundaries between Excellent, Good, Fair, Bad, and Poor. Positive confirmation delays require a second valid reading; 0 seconds reacts to the first reading. Returns to cleaner levels happen only after the configured delay. Activate these rules with the device's Custom Auto switch.

data.custom_auto_delay_40: Fair to Good: time at or below
data.custom_auto_delay_60: Bad to Fair: time at or below
data.custom_auto_delay_80: Poor to Bad: time at or below

data_description.custom_auto_confirmation_delay: Wait this many seconds before requesting a confirming PM2.5 reading. Set to 0 to increase immediately from the first valid reading.
